text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are numerous committees at Tracen Academy.
The Class Committee, the Disciplinary Committee, the Library Committee—
and among them, the "Beautification Committee."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Their duties include tending the flower beds and fields, managing the decorations throughout the academy, and cleaning living spaces—guardians responsible for maintaining a healthy environment for the school.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Good morningâGrass-san.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good morning, Bouquet-chan.
Breathing in the crisp morning air
truly cleanses the soul, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Good morning!
Everyone is always up so early...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That means all of today's duty members have gathered――doesn't it.
Well then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Our duties—as the Beautification Committee.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. We've pretty much
finished weeding everything, haven't we?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Good work—
The watering is finished too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It took a while for anything to sprout in this flower bed, but
...they're all thriving now, what a relief.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm really—glad.
It's going to get much, much livelier—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hm, hmm...♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
You seem to be in high spirits, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry.
My voice slipped out, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It's just—even with small pieces of trash, seeing it
get a little cleaner with each one I pick up—
feels really nice, somehow.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I understand how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Good work today. I'll take care of disposing of the collected trash."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Well then... I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you, as always.
Both as the student council and as a fellow student, you have my gratitude."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It may not be a glamorous job.
However, it is thanks to all of you that the academy's students
can live in a healthy and safe environment.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (It is true—our work is not the kind that stands out in a flashy way.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Even so—I love this job.
Because—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Oh. The flowers—they're scattering.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because the wind was so strong yesterday...
Even so many flowers that were still beautiful...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It pains me to leave it exposed to the elements.
Shall we put it away?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Um. I have a bit of an idea—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ho... This is a magnificent ornament.
Did you really make this using only fallen flowers?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes—it felt like a shame to throw them away...
so I tried tidying them up a bit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: How would you feel about this? If you don't mind—may we display it on the academy grounds...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mm. A splendid idea.
Naturally, I grant my permission.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Turning misfortune into a blessing—fufu.
That was a wonderful idea, so typical of Bouquet-chan.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Was there always a decoration here?"
"Still... it's so pretty~"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Yes. I—I love this job.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Because it's a job to keep everyone's academy beautiful, gorgeous,
and tidy――creating harmony.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon entering the trainer's office,
an unfamiliar flower decoration on the wall caught my eye.
This is—
choice_data_list: ...All right. You made this by hand, didn't you?
...All right. You made this by hand, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Did you notice...?
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, this room is really coming together.
Thanks to you, this room is coming together nicely.
Because you're radiating an “aura of harmony”...
Because you're radiating an “aura of harmony,” you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu.
Did you notice...?
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, this room is really coming together.
Thanks to you, this room is coming together nicely.
Because you're radiating an “aura of harmony”...
Because you're radiating an “aura of harmony,” you know...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufuâis that so?
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I'll do my best—and think of many more ways
to ensure that every time you visit,
your mind feels refreshed and centered."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...!
You can see... what they call an aura?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: What color... would that be, for example...?
choice_data_list: Huh... N-No, I was just kidding...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Fufufufuâ!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm only teasing, too.
...Just getting you back a little. Hehe.
